name: io.github.dziuba0x/flario
title: Flario — Flare Network
description: Give an agent proof-carrying access to Flare: FTSO prices with a Merkle proof verified locally against the on-chain root, FDC cross-chain attestations, FAssets state, and x402 payments that settle on the same chain they serve.

environmentVariables.name: FLARE_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Flare mainnet C-chain RPC. Defaults to the public endpoint https://flare-api.flare.network/ext/C/rpc.

environmentVariables.name: FLARE_RPC_TESTNET
environmentVariables.description: Coston2 testnet RPC. Defaults to the public endpoint https://coston2-api.flare.network/ext/C/rpc.

environmentVariables.name: FLARE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Only needed to submit FDC attestation requests on-chain or to broadcast an x402 settlement. Every read tool works without it.

environmentVariables.name: X402_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to turn on the x402 paywall for the two premium tools. Off by default, so premium tools are free.
